newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian O/N rates drop to close at 23.375 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian O/N rates drop to close at 23.375 pct.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates began their slide on Monday towards what traders considered "realistic" levels.
"Presently the normal range is somewhere around the one-week reverse repo rate of 22.75 percent," said Sandor Tolonics of Budapest Bank.
Overnight rates opened around 24 percent compared with Friday's close of 24.25 percent, but closed at around 23.375 percent, traders said.

Overnight rates hovered around 24 percent last week as traders diverted all available funds into the central bank's one-week reverse repo facility shortly before an expected repo rate cut that occurred September 16.
"Funds are coming back from the one-week reverse repo and as we are still a week away from the reserve period deadline, liquidity is higher and people are more relaxed," Tolonics added.
